primitives.note: Bel'Veth has no attack speed cap and no per-level AS growth; Royal Maelstrom's number of slashes scales with her bonus attack speed.
Permanent Lavender stacks (from takedowns) grant bonus attack speed, uncapped; a starting stack count must be assumed since the dummy fight has no qualifying takedowns.
Casting any ability grants 20% bonus AS for 3s, refreshing on every subsequent cast.
Void Surge resets Bel'Veth's basic attack timer.
Each Q direction's cooldown is reduced by bonus AS; W hitting the (champion) dummy resets the Q cooldown of the direction it was cast in.
Q can crit against the first target hit; E's slashes are affected by crit modifiers.

Q applies on-hit/life steal to the first target; E slashes apply on-hit/on-attack effects at reduced (missing-health-scaled) effectiveness; R's passive deals bonus true damage on every basic attack against the marked target.
Q dash damage, W tail-slam damage, and R's consume explosion each deal damage on/shortly after cast.
Royal Maelstrom is a 1.5s channel during which Bel'Veth cannot move and is locked into repeated auto-recast slashes.
E consists of multiple separately-resolved slash instances over its duration and can be recast (ended) manually after 0.75s or ends automatically.
Each E slash's damage and its on-hit portion scale with the target's current missing health (recomputed per slash); R's explosion damage scales with the target's missing health at cast.
Endless Banquet marks the attacked target for 5s (refreshed on hit); stacks accrue on that mark and raise subsequent on-hit true damage.
Endless Banquet's on-hit true-damage stacks are uncapped versus champions; a starting stack count (likely 0 at fight start) must be assumed.
Casting R's active transforms Bel'Veth into True Form, changing bonus health, attack range, and total attack speed for its duration.
E's damage reduction and life steal, and R's bonus health/heal, only matter for damage taken/self-sustain, not damage dealt to the dummy.

needsBespoke.why: Two mechanics fall outside the primitive list's expressive power. (1) Royal Maelstrom (E) has a slash count that is fixed once at cast time as a function of live bonus attack speed, but each individual slash's damage must be recomputed against the target's missing health as it changes slash-by-slash within the same channel, with on-hit/on-attack portions further scaled by a separate missing-health curve -- this is a dynamic per-hit recompute inside a variable-length multi-hit channel that 'conditional-damage' plus 'charge-or-channel' only partially capture. (2) Endless Banquet's active (R) requires targeting an existing 'Void Coral', which is only created by a takedown against a champion or epic monster; in a damage fight the target dummy never dies, so R's active/True Form may be structurally uncastable during the encounter unless the simulator fabricates a pre-placed Void Coral -- no primitive in the closed list models an ability gated on a spawned entity that the fight format itself may never produce.

unsettled.question: Does the bin's AttackSpeedMult=8 or the wiki's '1 extra slash per 40% bonus attack speed' (i.e. divisor 0.4, matching the literal used in BelvethE#TotalStrikes) govern how many bonus slashes Royal Maelstrom gets from bonus AS?
options: Use AttackSpeedMult=8 as the divisor for extra slashes
Use 0.4 (40% bonus AS per extra slash) as stated in the wiki and used literally in the calculation

unsettled.question: Can Bel'Veth's ultimate (R) active ever be cast in either fight, given it requires targeting a Void Coral that only spawns from a takedown against a champion/epic monster, and the damage-fight dummy never dies?
options: R's active is simply never cast in the damage/survival fights (only its passive on-hit true damage is used)
The simulator should assume a Void Coral is pre-placed at fight start so R can be cast once
The simulator should assume Bel'Veth already starts the fight in True Form (skipping the cast entirely)
quotes: '''Bel'Veth''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target ''Void Coral'' to consume it
A nearby Void Coral is required to cast this ability.

unsettled.question: How do Bel'Veth's simultaneous attack-speed sources (base/leveled AS, permanent Lavender stacks, the temporary 20% post-cast ghost buff, and True Form's total-AS mod) combine, given she has no AS cap?
options: All sources sum as bonus percentages before applying to base AS (standard League stacking)
Some sources (e.g. True Form's 'total attack speed' mod) apply as a separate multiplicative layer on top of the summed bonus percentage

unsettled.question: What starting Lavender stack count (permanent bonus AS) should be assumed for Bel'Veth at the start of the fight, since stacks are only gained from takedowns that a static dummy fight will not produce?
options: Assume some non-zero 'mid-game' stack count consistent with the champion's assumed level/gold

proposal: Open the fight by immediately casting Q (Void Surge) in one direction for physical damage, on-hit and a basic-attack-timer reset, then start auto-attacking the dummy.

If a Void Coral is assumed available at fight start (see unsettled), spend the 1s cast time on R first to gain True Form's bonus health/attack speed/range and the true-damage explosion, since it only needs to be done once and its buffs persist; otherwise skip R entirely and rely only on its always-active on-hit true-damage passive.

Cast W (Above and Below) on cooldown for magic damage; since it hits the (champion-flagged) dummy, use it to reset the Q cooldown in whichever direction is currently off cooldown, then immediately re-cast that Q.

Cast E (Royal Maelstrom) on cooldown and let it run its full 1.5s duration uninterrupted (do not cast Q/W mid-channel, since another ability cast auto-ends Maelstrom) to maximize the number of slashes, each benefiting from current bonus attack speed and the target's missing health.
Between W/E cooldowns, keep auto-attacking and firing whichever Q direction is off cooldown as filler, both for direct damage and to keep the post-cast 20% bonus-AS ghost buff continuously refreshed.
Continue this Q/W/E/auto-attack loop on cooldown for the full ~15s window, letting Endless Banquet's on-hit true-damage stacks build on the continuously-attacked dummy throughout.
questions: Should R ever be cast in this fight given the Void Coral precondition, or should the rotation exclude it entirely and rely only on its passive?
Does casting Q or W while Royal Maelstrom (E) is channeling actually cancel/end E early (per its own notes), meaning Q/W and E can never be interleaved, only sequenced before/after?
What starting level, item build, and pre-existing Lavender stack count should be assumed for computing bonus attack speed (which drives both attack frequency and E's slash count)?
Is it correct that Royal Maelstrom should be held for its full duration for max slashes, or would ending it early via recast to loop other cooldown-reduced abilities produce more damage over 15s?
